# sanity_project_invitation (Resource)

Manages a project member invitation for a Sanity.io project. Sends an email invitation granting the recipient access to the project with the specified role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Invite a developer to the project
resource "sanity_project_invitation" "developer" {
  project_id = sanity_project.example.id
  email      = "qa-lead@example.com"
  role       = "editor"
}

output "invitation_id" {
  value = sanity_project_invitation.developer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the person to invite.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Sanity project to invite the member to.
- `role` (String) The role to assign to the invited user (e.g. `viewer`, `editor`, `developer`, `administrator`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the invitation was sent.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the invitation (e.g. `vXJYs4Is`).
- `is_accepted` (Boolean) Whether the user has accepted the invitation.
- `is_revoked` (Boolean) Whether the invitation has been revoked.
